features.quote: the prompt tells the agent it *may* stop with a line beginning `TASK_UNSOLVABLE:` if it genuinely concludes the task can't be done
features.justification_quote: This matters for fairness: without a legitimate way to stop, "giving up" is conflated with "having no exit"

features.quote: We stop the loop on an explicit give-up or on repeated non-submission (no code block `max_no_code_turns` times)
features.justification_quote: This is cheaper (we don't pay for turns after the agent has checked out)
